subject: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions

Team —

Quick sync request while we finalize the NimbusHealth go-to-prod window (targeting Aug 18): a few interlocking questions I want to confirm before we lock the rollout runbook. Please reply inline if you own the item.

1) Docs: which pieces are "must ship" vs. post-launch? I have a living list below — we need green on: admin setup guide, RBAC FAQ, and SLA page.
2) Enablement: Nimbus asked for a live enablement session for their platform team the week of Aug 17. Grace, do we have a capacity slot and a staffed presenter?
3) Exceptions: legal flagged a data retention exception request from Nimbus for a 45-day log retention vs. our standard 90. Monica, are we ok to escalate a short exception?
4) Ops: David — any infrastructure blockers for canary within a single AZ?

Attachments: prod_deploy_checklist.pdf (draft) — please review the "deployment rollback" section in particular.

I know this is tight; trying to get an authoritative rollout plan by EOD Monday so we can surface to the executive update.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sr. PM, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions

Thanks Aditya — quick answers from Product/docs side: 

- Must ship before launch: Admin setup guide (short how-to), RBAC FAQ, and a one-page "Known limitations" doc. I can own the RBAC FAQ.
- Post-launch: full API reference and deep-dive tutorials (we can publish within 2 weeks post-launch).
- Action: I'll add owners and ETA to the Confluence page. Link: https://confluence.redwood/products/nimbus-g2p

Note: the SLA page copy is with Legal for a final clause check; Monica, is Legal likely to block publication prior to the signed exception? If so, we should put a placeholder and an "SLA pending" banner.

-Lauren
Product Docs Manager

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T13:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions

Aditya / team —

I can run the enablement session the week of Aug 17 but I have one other commitment on Aug 17 morning. Current availability: Aug 17 1–3pm PT or Aug 18 9–11am PT. I recommend Aug 17 afternoon since it gives Nimbus time to triage before we flip prod.

Staffing: I need one engineer (ops-facing) to be on the call for live troubleshooting. David, can you assign someone for 90 minutes?

Also: the enablement_slide_draft.pptx is attached — Lauren, can you add the RBAC FAQ slide and a short "what to expect during canary" checklist?

- Grace
Enablement Lead

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions

Folks —

Ops notes: single-AZ canary is fine for initial traffic shaping, but two caveats:
- We need pre-provisioned burst capacity (I put numbers in the attached prod_deploy_checklist.pdf). If Nimbus ramps faster than expected we'll need auto-burst to Dedicated to avoid throttles.
- Monitoring: add the latency SLO dashboard to the runbook (see OPS-4312). I can have a runbook snippet by EOD tomorrow.

I've tentatively assigned Priya from on-call to be the engineer on the enablement call (Grace, can you confirm she is OK with the 90-minute window?).

-David
Senior Engineering Manager, Infra

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T15:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions

Quick legal/procurement update: Legal has reviewed Nimbus's 45-day retention request. They are open to a limited, documented exception for specific log classes (access logs only), subject to:

- A signed amendment (we'll use the one-page Exception Addendum template).
- Additional data access controls: RBAC verification and review every 90 days.

If Product is comfortable publishing the SLA with an "exception pending" banner, Legal will prepare the addendum in parallel so it does not block enablement.

Also: Procurement asked whether Nimbus will sign the standard EULA or if we need to pursue their paper — they said standard EULA is acceptable but asked for a slightly accelerated signature window (5 business days).

-Monica
Head of Legal Ops

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: NimbusHealth - Julia Kaplan <julia@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Go-to-prod scope: clarify docs, enablement slots, and exceptions

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

- Docs: Lauren to own RBAC FAQ and publish admin setup guide by Aug 12 (placeholder SLA page with "exception pending").
- Enablement: Grace runs session Aug 17 1–3pm PT; David to confirm Priya.
- Exceptions: Monica will route the Exception Addendum; Legal will draft and circulate today so Procurement can request signature within 5 business days.
- Ops: David will attach the runbook snippet to OPS-4312 and finalize the pre-provision numbers in prod_deploy_checklist.pdf.

Aditya (will produce the rollout one-pager and circulate by EOD Aug 5).
